faqs.q: What are the AME International electric pumps used for?
faqs.a: AME International electric pumps are 2 gallon and 2.5 gallon electric fuel and oil pumps with a 1/2 hp motor on one model. The listing carries 3 part numbers: 15700, 15705 and 15710.

faqs.q: Which sizes are the AME International electric pumps available in?
faqs.a: The listing carries 3 part numbers: 15700 (2 gallon, 2 speed), 15705 (2.5 gallon, 1/2 hp motor) and 15710 (2.5 gallon, 1-1/8 hp motor).

faqs.q: How should I select the AME International electric pumps for my application?
faqs.a: Choose the reservoir, 2 gallons or 2.5 gallons, and the motor, 1/2 hp or 1-1/8 hp, from the item name. The listing gives no pressure on the rows.

faqs.q: What working pressure applies to the AME International electric pumps?
faqs.a: The listing gives no pressure rating on its rows for the AME International electric pumps, so we do not quote one. The rating is set by the model, so quote the part number and we confirm the rated pressure, flow and reservoir size with the maker.

faqs.q: Which materials are the AME International electric pumps offered in?
faqs.a: The listing does not state the reservoir or housing material of the AME International electric pumps. Quote the part number and we confirm the build, such as aluminium or steel reservoir, with the maker before you order.

faqs.q: Which standards and documents apply to the AME International electric pumps?
faqs.a: The listing names no ISO, ASME or EN standard for the AME International electric pumps and holds no certificates. If your site needs a test certificate or a conformity document, say so in the enquiry and we ask the maker what it can issue. See [our guide to high-pressure cylinders and pumps](/blog/high-pressure-hydraulic-cylinders-and-pumps).

faqs.q: What do the AME International electric pumps connect to?
faqs.a: The AME International electric pumps connect to a cylinder or tool through a hose and a coupler rated for the pump's pressure. The supply voltage and the valve type in the part number must match the cylinder and the site supply.

faqs.q: How do I fit and look after the AME International electric pumps?
faqs.a: Fit the AME International electric pumps on a level base, check the supply voltage against the nameplate, fill with clean oil and bleed the hose before loading. Set the relief valve for the cylinder, keep within the duty cycle and check oil level and filters on the maker's schedule.

faqs.q: Which industries and jobs use the AME International electric pumps?
faqs.a: The AME International electric pumps are used to drive cylinders, torque wrenches, tensioners and presses where mains power is available, in plants, workshops, shipyards and on construction sites.

faqs.q: How do the AME International electric pumps differ from the AME International hydraulic pumps?
faqs.a: The AME electric pumps are 3 part numbers of 2 to 2.5 gallons, while [the AME International hydraulic pumps](/p/ame-international-hydraulic-pumps) are 26 part numbers of 2 quart to 5 quart with 10,000 psi. Choose by the reservoir.

faqs.q: Where are the AME International electric pumps shipped from, and what origin and HS code apply?
faqs.a: We ship the AME International electric pumps from our Dubai, UAE warehouse to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond. The country of origin depends on the plant that made the batch and is stated on the commercial invoice. Export documents come with the order; ask on [our contact page](/contact).
